title: Motion Graphics Designer / Video Editor
description:
Remote | Contract to Full Time



About Us

We are a woman owned creative studio based in Los Angeles, California working with VTubers, streamers, content creators, and digital brands.



Our focus is building internet native media such as motion graphics, intro videos, creator branding, thumbnails, announcement videos, website visuals, and social media content.



We are a small but growing studio that values creativity, collaboration, and initiative. We are looking for someone who understands online culture, streaming content, and modern video trends and wants to grow with a team from the ground up.



This role will start as contract work so we can build a strong workflow together. The goal is to transition into a full time role with benefits as the company grows.



This is a fully remote position, but there may be opportunities in the future to collaborate internationally with creator agencies, animation studios, and content creators, including potential travel to Japan, Los Angeles, and other creative hubs for events and projects.



What You Will Be Creating

You will help creators build their visual identity and online presence.



Projects may include

• Motion graphics and animated intro videos using tools like After Effects

• Editing previous livestreams into polished content for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

• Cutting stream highlights and clips for short form content

• Creator announcement videos and promotional trailers

• Eye catching thumbnails that match a creator’s theme

• Stream graphics, icons, and branding assets

• Website visuals and design elements

• Creative marketing clips and promotional content

• Occasional faceless UGC videos for sponsored campaigns



The focus is motion graphics and video editing, not frame by frame animation.



Responsibilities

• Create motion graphics and intro animations using After Effects or similar tools

• Edit long livestream recordings into engaging highlight videos and short form clips

• Follow current editing trends used by streamers and YouTube creators

• Design thumbnails, icons, and digital assets that match creator branding

• Collaborate with the Creative Lead while bringing your own creative ideas and direction to projects

• Take initiative to improve concepts and elevate project quality

• Organize project files and deliver clean editable assets



What We Are Looking For

• Experience with Adobe After Effects for motion graphics

• Video editing experience using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

• Ability to turn livestream footage into engaging edited content

• Strong visual design sense and pacing for online content

• Understanding of internet culture, streaming, and social media video trends

• Reliable communication in a remote work environment

• Ability to manage creative projects and meet deadlines



Bonus Skills

• Experience with Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or Illustrator

• Understanding of popular editing styles used by streamers and gaming creators

• Familiarity with popular video games and gaming communities

• Thumbnail design experience for YouTube

• Basic website visual or UI design knowledge

• Motion branding or logo animation experience



Growth Opportunity

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the studio long term.



As the company expands, this role can grow into a Lead Creative position, helping guide future editors and designers on the team.



We believe in rewarding strong work and initiative. Tea
mbers may receive equipment upgrades, bonuses, or gifted gear based on growth, performance, and KPIs.



Work Setup

• Fully remote

• Contract work to start

• Opportunity to transition into full time employment with benefits

• Chill creative studio environment

• Opportunity to collaborate with creators and agencies around the world



Compensation

• Hourly rate $11 to $15 USD per hour depending on experience and portfolio

• Opportunity for pay increases based on performance and project growth

• Looking for a mid level Motion Graphics Designer with 4+ years of experience



How to Apply

Please include the following with your application



• A link to your portfolio or motion graphics work

• Examples of stream edits, intro animations, or social media video content you have created

• A short answer to this question



Which YouTuber, VTuber, or streamer do you think has great editing and why?

title: Omni-Channel Support Specialist
description:
SuperOrdinary is a growing company seeking an exceptional individual to join our Account Health team. As an Account Health Specialist, you will play a vital role in maintaining the health, compliance, and customer experience of our marketplace accounts across Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Vendor Central, Walmart Seller Center, and Target Plus. You will support a growing portfolio of brands, ensuring listings stay live and compliant, policy issues get resolved quickly, and buyers receive fast, professional service on every channel. This role includes weekend coverage as part of the standard work week to ensure consistent buyer response times and account health monitoring. We are looking for a marketplace-savvy, dependable, and passionate individual who enjoys learning new skills and is committed to delivering exceptional results.



Responsibilities and Duties:



Execute routine product updates and launch new products across all supported marketplaces, including content updates, product images, attributions, item data uploads, and category adjustments.

Create new product listings on Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Vendor Central, Walmart Seller Center, and Target Plus, adhering to each platform's required guidelines and standards.

Utilize bulk upload tools and templates — including Amazon Inventory flat files and Walmart bulk item spec files — to efficiently make listing updates across multiple listings and brands.

Resolve policy violations and compliance issues across all marketplaces to maintain a high level of account health and seller standing.

Respond to customer and buyer messages across Amazon, Walmart, and Target, meeting or exceeding each marketplace's required response time, including weekends and some US holidays.

Manage customer service inquiries end to end, including order issues, shipping and delivery questions, product questions, and replacements, escalating to internal teams or brand partners when needed.

Process customer returns across Amazon, Walmart, and Target, including reviewing return requests, issuing return authorizations, tracking return status, and resolving return-related buyer disputes.

Process management-approved refunds accurately and within marketplace deadlines, maintaining clear documentation of approvals and refund reasons for audit and reporting purposes.

title: Social Media Specialist (Content Creator)
description:
About Homeish

Homeish is a new website and soon-to-be mobile app for home enthusiasts. We give homeowners, renters, and property owners a utility-focused platform to manage, track, and archive everything they do to their home – from project budgets to timelines, photos, and ideas – and share it with other home enthusiasts. We prioritize an authentic, real-life utility brand over high-gloss corporate polish. We also follow a strict "No-Noise" Rule—meaning our platform and content are 100% free from politics, news, sports, and controversial topics. 



The Role

We are looking for a creative, highly organized Social Media Specialist to design and draft social media content for our brand.

Important: Your role is to create content for review. You will upload graphics, carousels, videos, and captions into our scheduling platform (PostFlow), which our team will review before publishing.



Primary Responsibilities

-->Platform Content Creation: Suggestions below, but you are the expert and we are looking to you to lead and execute the social media strategy.

*Instagram: Design "Aesthetic Utility" carousels featuring home ideas and organized timelines.

*TikTok: Create UI walkthroughs and "Silent Solutions" (ASMR/lo-fi) style short video content.


: Draft trust-building community posts, "Neighbor" advice threads, and home milestone posts.

*Reddit: Seed engaging, helpful conversations in niche subreddits (e.g., r/Homeish).

-->Content Pillars: Focus on raw "Before & After" or "In-Progress" footage, high-quality room imagery, and direct home management tips.

-->Social SEO: Write SEO-friendly captions using high-density keywords (e.g., "home project tracker," "renovation timeline") in the first two lines.

-->Scheduling: Set up all draft posts inside PostFlow for quick team approval.



Hard Skills Required

-->Graphic & Video Design: Proficiency in Canva, Figma, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite or other graphic/video design software.

-->Social SEO: Strong understanding of keyword optimization for Instagram and TikTok captions.

-->Content Adaptation: Ability to take one concept and format it cleanly across multiple platforms (IG, TikTok,
, Reddit).

-->Tool Familiarity: Experience using social schedulers like PostFlow.



Soft Skills Required

-->Lo-Fi Aesthetic Sense: Ability to appreciate and create real, raw, "authentic" content rather than overly glossy, corporate ads.

-->Attention to Detail: Excellent written English skills with a clean, organized, and helpful brand voice.

-->Self-Starter: Able to work independently following our brand guidelines.



How to Apply

To apply, please send a message with the following:

-->Subject Line: Must be "Homeish Content Creator - [Your Name]"

-->First Sentence of Your Message: Start your message with a description of one home project you’ve done so we know you’ve read this entire job post. 

-->Portfolio/Work Samples: Links to 2–3 examples of social graphics, carousels, or TikTok/Reels you’ve designed.

-->Tool Experience: Briefly list what design and scheduling tools you use daily.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

You’ll also use AI tools such as ChatGPT to help research, organize ideas, prepare first drafts, and work more efficiently.



Who I’m Looking For

You may be a great fit if you are:

Exceptionally organized and dependable

A strong written and spoken English communicator

Proficient with Canva and Google Workspace

Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools

A strong online researcher

Detail-oriented and good at following through

Comfortable learning new software

Able to manage several different projects at once

Resourceful and willing to figure things out

Interested in education, leadership, girls’ development, entrepreneurship, or mission-driven work



Most importantly, I’m looking for someone who is proactive AND communicative.

If you notice something that needs attention, I want you to notice it. If you have an idea for how something could work better, I want you to suggest it. At the same time, especially while we are learning how to work together, I want someone who keeps me informed and checks in rather than making assumptions.

As trust develops, so will independence and responsibility.



How We’ll Work Together

This will be a close working relationship.

For the first several weeks, I anticipate having a brief Zoom check-in on most working days so we can review priorities, answer questions, and establish good systems together.

As we develop a rhythm, that will likely taper to three meetings per week and eventually approximately two regular check-ins each week.

Because I am based in North Carolina, you must have some working availability that overlaps with U.S. Eastern Time during daytime/early-evening hours. Very early morning and late-night meetings will not generally be required.

Between meetings, we’ll communicate electronically and use shared systems to keep projects and priorities organized.



The Opportunity

This position will begin at approximately 8–10 hours per week at $10–12 USD/hour, with an initial paid trial period.

If we work well together and HighHER TogetHER continues to grow, there is potential for the role, hours, responsibilities, and compensation to grow as well.

I’m hoping to find more than someone who can complete tasks. I’d love to find someone who enjoys helping build something from the ground up and who could become an important long-term part of HighHER TogetHER.



HighHER TogetHER – Applicant Screening Questions

1. Relevant Experience

Tell me about the person, entrepreneur, or small business you have supported most closely. What did you actually handle for them on a day-to-day or week-to-week basis?

2. Proactivity

You notice that I have an information session coming up in five days, but nothing has been posted on social media yet. I haven't asked you to do anything about it. What would you do?

3. Judgment & Communication

You are preparing an
 to parents and realize you are missing one piece of information. I am unavailable for several hours. What would you do?

4. Organization

On Monday, you are given several things that need attention during the week. Some have firm deadlines, some involve waiting for responses from other people, and some are longer-term projects. Walk me through how you would organize and manage the work.

5. AI Experience

Tell me specifically how you have used ChatGPT or another AI tool in your work. Please give me at least one example of something it helped you accomplish faster or better.

6. Canva Experience

Please share links or samples of 1–3 Canva materials that you personally created. Briefly tell me what each piece was created for and what part of the work you handled yourself.

7. Managing Multiple Workstreams

In this role, you may be helping with several different projects at the same time—for example, preparing a Canva post, researching a grant, coordinating an upcoming program session, and tracking enrollment follow-ups. How would you organize your work so that priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups don't get lost?

title: Virtual Stylist & Wardrobe Curator (Hourly, Temporary)
description:
About the Role

I’m looking for a thoughtful, fashion-minded virtual stylist to help me bring order, creativity, and fresh vision to my existing wardrobe. I’ve already photographed my clothes, shoes, bags, and jewelry. Now, I need your eye to help me put it all together.



This is a remote position where you’ll help me create styled looks for different parts of my life: speaking engagements, church services, real estate client meetings, casual outings, travel days, and formal events. We’ll use the Indyx iOS app to build and organize my wardrobe, and I’ll cover the premium subscription if needed.



You won’t need to shop for me or build a wardrobe from scratch. I simply need help refining and coordinating what I already own into outfits that are appropriate, elegant, and true to who I am.



A Little About Me



I’m a minister, real estate broker, and author based in Tennessee. I show up in many different spaces — from pulpits to closing tables to Sunday brunch — and I want my wardrobe to reflect confidence, modesty, purpose, and grace. My style is a blend of sophistication and professionalism, with a touch of Afrocentric flair.



What You’ll Be Doing:

Access my wardrobe photos inside the Indyx app and help me organize them by category, color, and occasion

Create polished and appropriate outfits for specific events like:



Sunday services

Real estate closings and networking

Speaking engagements (in person and virtual)

Brunch or lunch with friends

Travel and formal events

Build lookbooks and mood boards in the app so I can easily find what to wear

Tag each item and outfit with helpful details like occasion, season, and location

Suggest styling adjustments, accessory pairings, or layering options

Use the app’s built-in photo editor to clean up background images and help the catalog look its best

Provide brief notes or explanations for each outfit so I understand how to pull it together myself



What I’m Looking For:



Someone with experience in styling, wardrobe curation, or fashion coordination

A person who understands how to work with modest, professional, ministry-appropriate clothing

Comfortable using iOS and willing to work inside the Indyx app (training provided if needed)

Organized and good at communicating clearly and kindly

Someone who enjoys helping others look and feel their best

Bonus if you have experience building digital lookbooks or working with speakers or professionals

Details:



This is a short-term project paid by the hour

Please include your hourly rate when you apply



We’ll begin with a paid trial task (such as styling 3 to 5 looks) and move from there



I’d love to get started right away, with the project expected to last around 3 to 4 weeks, depending on how we pace it



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your styling background

Your hourly rate

Any examples of work you’ve done; especially for clients who speak, teach, or lead professionally

Confirmation that you use an iOS device and are open to working inside the Indyx app

Training & Support ? Load Recommendations ? Controlled Decisions ? Independent Management of 2–3 Trucks

title: Social Media Manager: Content Strategy & Calendar (Botanical Gray Market Industry)
description:
We have three business brands plus our CEO personal brand posting. We need someone who owns why, when, and what next.



Rebel X Brands is a botanical house. We build and hold consumer brands across kratom, kava, and alcohol-alternative wellness, including GRHKratom, King K, and GÜD Tonics. Each brand has its own voice and its own audience. We need a social media manager who owns the full picture: strategy, calendar, and craft.



We need a Social Media Manager who can build the content calendar and strategy for all three brands and work directly with our Marketing Manager, our Graphic Designer, and our Video Editor to get the content made. Paid social experience is a nice-to-have here, not a requirement.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Content calendars and strategy for GRHKratom, King K, and GÜD Tonics, each with its own voice, content pillars, and posting cadence

- Creative briefs for our Graphic Designer and Video Editor, covering static posts and quick-turn video

- Platform strategy that accounts for the fact that Meta and TikTok both restrict kratom and kava content; you'll need to know or learn the workarounds (code words, visual language, avoiding flagged terms) that keep our accounts live

- Weekly and monthly reporting tied to engagement and growth, not just vanity metrics



**Nice to have: planning and running paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other channels



OUR CEO'S PERSONAL BRAND

You'll also build the content plan and strategy for our CEO's personal brand and account, working with the same Graphic Designer and Video Editor on his static posts and short-form video

This calendar runs alongside the brand calendars, coordinated with our Marketing Manager and, where relevant, a separate Personal Branding/PR Strategist who handles our CEO's outreach and press



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

- You'll report to our Marketing Manager for cross-brand priorities and approvals

- Our Graphic Designer, for static creative

- Our Video Editor, for short-form and quick-turn video

- A separate Personal Branding/PR Strategist for our CEO: you own his content calendar, they own his outreach and opportunities



REQUIREMENTS

- A track record building and executing content calendars and strategy for more than one brand at a time

- Experience or comfort working in a restricted advertising category (supplements, CBD, kratom, kava, alcohol alternatives, or similar); you understand platforms restrict certain words and topics, and you know how to plan around it

- Direct experience briefing and collaborating with designers and video editors, not just posting what's handed to you

- Understanding that in our category we make zero medical claims, ever



**Nice to have: hands-on graphic design or video editing skills (Canva, Adobe Suite, CapCut, or similar) — you don't need to be the primary creative, but being able to jump in and create or edit content yourself is a plus



**Nice to have: experience running paid social ads (Meta and TikTok) with real budget and real results



TO APPLY

Skip the generic proposal. Include:

- A content calendar or strategy you built across more than one brand, and how you sequenced it

- If you have one, a paid social campaign you ran with real numbers (spend, CAC, ROAS, whatever you tracked)

- Anything you see yourself working on when you look at our social media pages?

- Answer this: "Instagram just flagged one of your posts and quietly reduced its reach because it contains a restricted keyword. What do you check first, and what do you change going forward?"

title: Growth & Outreach Virtual Assistant – Early-Stage Startup
description:
About Chinwag



Chinwag is an early-stage Irish startup building a marketplace for paid one-to-one video conversations.



The idea is simple: people can create a profile around their knowledge, interests or lived experience and get paid for their time, while others can discover and book conversations with people they would value speaking to.



The MVP is live. We're now tackling the harder part: finding our first users, learning what resonates and building momentum.



The role



I'm looking for a smart, resourceful Growth & Outreach VA to work with me for approximately 5 hours per week.



This isn't primarily an administrative VA role. The focus will be helping generate genuine activity around an early-stage startup through research, outreach, community participation and content.



Typical work will include:



• Researching potential early users and prospective Hosts

• Identifying relevant online communities and conversations

• Helping with thoughtful outreach to potential users

• Engaging with relevant discussions across platforms such as X, LinkedIn, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers and Reddit

• Repurposing founder ideas into social posts and other content

• Researching potential partnerships and promotional opportunities

• Keeping a simple record of outreach, responses and results

• Suggesting experiments and new ways of reaching potential users



Who I'm looking for



You don't need years of startup experience. I'm much more interested in someone who:



• Has excellent written English

• Is curious and comfortable researching unfamiliar topics

• Can use AI tools effectively without producing generic AI content

• Understands social media and online communities

• Can exercise judgement rather than simply following instructions

• Is comfortable working independently

• Is willing to suggest better approaches when they see them



Chinwag is at a very early stage, so there will be experimentation. Some approaches will work and others won't. I'm looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than frustrating.



Hours & longer-term potential



The role will initially be approximately 5 hours per week. If we work well together and the activity begins producing results, there is scope for the hours and responsibilities to grow over time.



I'll provide detailed guidance on Chinwag's brand, objectives, target audiences and ways of working.



How to apply



Please keep your application relatively short. Tell me:



Why this particular role interests you.

One way you would try to find potential early users for Chinwag.

An example of previous work involving research, outreach, content or social media.



Please also begin your application with the word “Chinwag” so I know you've read the full description.

title: Cold calling agent with lead generation
description:
Property Management Cold Caller & Lead Manager



RokLan Group | Remote Position



About the Role



RokLan Group is looking for a driven, organized Cold Caller & Lead Manager to help grow our property management portfolio.



Your primary responsibility is simple:



Find rental property owners and landlords, start conversations with them, identify their pain points, and book qualified appointments with our team.



You will also be responsible for managing leads inside our CRM and consistently following up until the owner is ready to have a conversation about property management.



This is a sales position, not a customer service or administrative position. We are looking for someone who is comfortable making outbound calls every day and being measured by results.



What You’ll Do



* Make high-volume outbound calls to rental property owners and landlords

* Contact owners of single-family homes, townhomes, condos, small multifamily properties, and rental portfolios

* Identify landlords who may be:

    * Self-managing and tired of dealing with tenants

    * Struggling to fill vacancies

    * Dealing with late rent or problem tenants

    * Living out of state

    * Managing multiple properties themselves

    * Unhappy with their current property management company

    * Looking to expand or simplify their portfolio

* Explain the value of professional property management

* Qualify owners based on property type, location, number of units, current management situation, and motivation

* Book appointments for qualified property owners with our acquisition/property management team

* Enter every lead, conversation, note, and follow-up into our CRM

* Maintain an organized sales pipeline

* Follow up by phone, text, and
 when appropriate

* Re-engage old leads who were not ready initially

* Keep leads moving through the pipeline until they become an appointment, client, or confirmed dead lead

* Provide daily reporting on calls, contacts, appointments, and pipeline activity



Your Main Objective



We are not hiring someone simply to make calls.



We are hiring someone to generate new property management clients.



Your job is to turn:



Owner Data ? Conversations ? Qualified Leads ? Appointments ? New Management Accounts



Our team will handle closing qualified opportunities, but you are responsible for creating and nurturing those opportunities.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, real estate, property management, or B2B sales experience

* Speak fluent, professional English

* Are confident talking with property owners

* Can handle rejection without losing momentum

* Are comfortable making a large number of outbound calls

* Understand that most sales happen through follow-up

* Are extremely organized

* Have experience using a CRM

* Can follow scripts while still sounding natural

* Are competitive and motivated by performance bonuses

* Can work independently without constant supervision



Real estate or property management experience is preferred but not required. We can teach the industry to someone who already knows how to sell.



CRM & Lead Management Responsibilities



Every lead must have:



* Correct owner/contact information

* Property address

* Number/type of rental units

* Current management situation

* Notes from every conversation

* Motivation/pain points

* Lead status

* Next follow-up date

* Appointment information when applicable



No lead should ever disappear because someone forgot to follow up.



Example Opening



“Hi, is this [Owner Name]?



My name is [Name] with RokLan Group. I’m reaching out because we work with rental property owners in the area and I wanted to see if you’re currently managing the property at [Property Address] yourself or if you already have a management company?”



From there, your job is to have a conversation—not immediately pitch.



Questions You’ll Learn to Ask



* How many rental properties do you currently own?

* Are you managing them yourself?

* How much time are you spending managing the properties?

* How are you currently handling leasing and tenant placement?

* Are you happy with your current management company?

* Do you have any vacancies coming up?

* What is the biggest headache you have with your rentals right now?

* If you could make the portfolio completely passive, would that interest you?

* Would you be open to a quick conversation with our team to see what management would look like?



Performance Expectations



We will track:



Outbound Calls ? Owner Contacts ? Qualified Leads ? Appointments Set ? Appointments Held ? Management Agreements Signed ? Units Added



Activity matters, but results matter more.



Expected baseline:



* 100+ outbound call attempts per working day

* Consistent CRM updates

* Daily follow-up activity

* Weekly pipeline review

* Strong appointment quality

* Continuous improvement in contact-to-appointment conversion



Compensation



We want compensation heavily aligned with performance.



Suggested structure:



Base Pay: $5–$8/hour depending on experience



Plus Performance Bonuses:



* Bonus for qualified appointments that actually show

* Additional bonus when an owner signs a management agreement

* Additional incentive based on the number of doors/units brought under management



High performers should have the ability to make substantially more than the base rate.



Schedule



Remote position.



Primary calling hours will overlap with normal U.S. business hours.



Monday–Friday with specific hours established during hiring.



Technology



You should be comfortable working with:



* CRM software

* Calling/dialer software

* Text and
 follow-up

* Google Workspace

* Property and owner lead lists

* Property management software/workflows



Training will be provided on RokLan Group’s specific systems and processes.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A short description of your cold-calling or sales experience

3. Your previous sales KPIs, if available

4. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at calling rental property owners

5. Your desired hourly rate

6. Your availability during U.S. business hours



Important: Start your application with the words “ROKLAN OWNER GROWTH” so we know you read the entire posting.



What Success Looks Like



The right person becomes the engine behind RokLan Group’s owner-acquisition pipeline.



You aren’t just dialing numbers.



You’re consistently identifying landlords with problems, building relationships, staying on top of follow-up, and putting qualified property owners in front of our team so we can bring more doors under management.

Are you detail-obsessed, a fast learner, and great with customers in writing? Do you want to grow with a small, hardworking shop instead of being a number at a big company?



I run a personalized-gift shop and I'm looking for one reliable teammate to help me keep customers happy and orders flowing. This starts part-time and focused, and grows over time into a bigger role as we build trust and a rhythm that works for both of us.



This begins with a 60-day trial so we can both make sure it's a great fit. You do not need any Etsy experience. I would honestly rather train you fresh on my exact system than undo old habits. What I can't teach is being careful, being kind to customers, and actually reading instructions, so that's what I'm hiring for.



What You'll Do (starting out)



Answer customer messages in a warm, professional, on-brand way

Process daily orders through our print partners (all in the browser, I'll train you step by step)

Make small updates to product listings when I ask

Flag anything unusual to me instead of guessing

Send me a short end-of-day summary of what you handled



What It Grows Into



As you get comfortable and prove you're precise, the role expands. You'll start with our Etsy shop, and over time that can grow to include helping with our Shopify store as well, creating full new product listings, keyword and SEO research, and taking on more of the customized orders that need extra care. If you have a good design eye or any Canva or Illustrator familiarity, that's a real plus for working accurately with our product files, and it is not required to start.



What I'm Looking For



Fluent, natural written English

Excellent, patient customer service instincts

Extreme attention to detail and a personal error rate under 1%

Someone who reads instructions fully and follows them exactly

Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable learning new browser tools

Reliable internet and your own computer

Available 7 days a week in short sessions, 1 to 3 hours a day, with a session earlier in your day and another in your evening (your evening overlaps our US customers' daytime), with flexibility for the occasional planned day off

Flexible on hours as we head into the busy holiday season

Willing to focus on this shop and not take on competing Etsy work

Bonus: a keen eye for design, and any Canva or Illustrator familiarity



The Setup



Part-time to start, with the real possibility of more hours and a bigger role as the shop grows

Competitive hourly pay with performance bonuses for low error rates

Weekly pay

A split shift each day (a short session in the morning and another in the evening) so customers never wait long

You work from your own computer, in your browser, using the shop accounts I set up for you



How To Apply (read carefully, both steps required)



Reply to this job with your resume attached inside your message.

Complete this short screening quiz: 



If you do not do BOTH of these, I won't be able to consider your application. Applicants who complete the quiz thoughtfully and follow every instruction will move to the next round. I read every one.

title: Social Media Content Editor & Creator Coordinator | Amazon Brands
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across the US, CA, UK, EU, AU and JP - two brands (travel accessories and beauty devices), 52+ active SKUs, on Amazon and our own websites. This role owns social media for both brands and sits in our Creative team.



The Role

You won't start from an empty folder. We already hold a library of influencer and UGC content, and more arrives continuously. Your job is to turn that supply into a consistent, well-edited output across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and
 - and to keep two very different brand voices distinct. Short-form vertical video is the default format.



This is a hands-on content role - not posting-only, and not purely strategic. You edit, you publish, and you run our creator pipeline.



What You'll Own

- Editing short-form vertical video to a publishable standard- on your own, quickly, without waiting for anyone.

- Turning raw creator footage, stock and product assets into finished posts, native to each platform - the same idea shaped differently as a Reel, a TikTok and a Short.

- Sourcing, vetting, briefing and negotiating creators for both brands, with usage rights agreed in writing before the shoot.

- Running the UGC pipeline: brief what you need, chase delivery, keep a clear record of every asset - who made it, what rights we hold, how long they run.

- A short weekly report: what published, what worked, audience growth.



What You'll Grow Into

Setting the social strategy and content pillars for both brands; running paid social on Meta and TikTok;
 capture and follower-to-customer flows; and TikTok Shop's affiliate programme. 



Who We're Looking For

- A fast, self-sufficient editor with a portfolio you edited or directed.

- 3+ years running social and creator content for a consumer brand.

- You know why a video holds attention in the first two seconds.

- Comfortable with CapCut, Meta's Edits or Premiere, and Canva.

- You can tell a valuable, relevant audience from a large-but-low-quality follower count.

- Solid written English. 

- E-commerce experience, ideally website + marketplace, is a plus.



Tools

- Instagram, TikTok, YouTube,
 (and their native analytics) 

- CapCut / Meta Edits / Premiere 

· Canva · 

- Notion or ClickUp 

-  a cross-posting tool like Later



Compensation & Setup

- $900–$1,000/month

- Full-time, 40h/week, remote

- 14 days paid leave per year



To Apply - Required

Answer only from your own experience, and name the real company or account each answer comes from. We're not asking what you would do - we're asking what you actually did. Generic or AI-written answers that don't tie to real work won't move forward.



1. Describe a short-form video you edited at a named company or account. What was the raw material, what did you change and in which tool, and what was it for?

2. Take one creator you sourced and worked with at a company on your CV — who were they (handle or follower band), what did you pay, what usage rights did you agree, and how did the content perform?

3. Tell us about a time you turned down or dropped a creator or audience that looked good on paper — big follower count - because you judged it wasn't worth it. What told you?

4. One piece of content or campaign from your CV that drove a measurable result — the numbers, and where they came from.



Please include your salary expectation and availability.

title: Video Editor (Short-Form TikTok Videos)
description:
We are seeking a talented Video Editor for TikTok Shop content.



While we provide hands-on training to help you master our specific style, this role requires a solid foundation in editing. You must understand the basics of viewer retention, pacing, and what makes a video engaging. We provide detailed instructions and structured training. If you are willing to learn, adapt quickly, and have a strong drive to create high-retention content, we want to hear from you.



Responsibilities: Edit short-form product videos using professional desktop software (DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro only).



Study and execute our brand guidelines and training materials before incorporating your own creative style. This is the most critical requirement. We have a highly specific aesthetic, and consistently ignoring instructions or guidelines will result in termination.



Trim out mistakes and silent portions of raw footage, adding B-roll where necessary.



Enhance engagement by adding captions, subtle zoom effects, sound effects, and brand-aligned creative text.



Incorporate our signature "Big Caption" style—specifically using large, dynamic, high-impact captions for the first 3 seconds of the video to maximize viewer hook and retention.



Optimize strictly for TikTok (vertical format, fast pacing, strong hooks).



Study our content 
 on TikTok to deeply understand and replicate our visual style (especially our hook caption style).



Maintain an efficient workflow by utilizing automated tools for captions rather than wasting time doing them manually.



Requirements



Software: You MUST use DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro. CapCut and mobile editing apps are strictly not allowed for this workflow.



Hardware: You must have decent computer hardware capable of editing and playing back 4K footage smoothly without lag.



Experience: A portfolio of short-form video work (clips, personal projects, or client work) demonstrating your technical skills.



Communication: Fast response times and reliable communication during working hours are non-negotiable.



Availability: Monday through Friday, at least a few hours a day.



Pay Structure: Starting pay is $5 per completed video (plus frequent bonuses based on performance), with raises based on performance. You are paid for approved videos that follow our instructions and meet our quality standards.



Work Hours: Flexible hours, but deadlines are strict. You will have plenty of time to finish videos, but you must communicate immediately if a delay occurs.



Test Project (Pass/Fail)

To be considered, you must complete a short test project using provided raw clips and a reference video to prove your technical ability and attention to detail.



Strict Export Settings: Deliver in vertical format (9:16), 1080x1920 at 60fps. Export using HEVC / H.265 compression and upload in Quicktime / .mov format. Failing to use these exact export settings will result in automatic disqualification.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
Senior Copywriter

REMOTE | FULL TIME | THE ROSA INSTITUTE



Write the Words That Change Lives



In this role, the words you write do more than change lives. They help create them.



You believe true professionals lead themselves first and set the example.



You don't need micromanaging. You don't need babysitting. You need a platform to do your best work, alongside great people who expect the same of themselves.



You hold yourself to world-class standards and best practices. You deliver outstanding results. And you want your work to serve a mission that changes lives.



If any of this is out of alignment with you, this is not your role. If you just said yes to all of the above, keep reading.





About Us

The Rosa Institute is a leading, evidence-based fertility practice, headquartered in Sydney, Australia, and serving patients worldwide by telehealth. Our signature program, The Fertility Breakthrough Program™, has a documented 78.8% live birth rate.¹ Our founder, Dr. Gabriela Rosa, is a clinician-scientist in practice since 2001, trained at the University of Sydney and the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.



- Our mission: Help couples overcome difficulty conceiving and recurrent miscarriage, even when other treatments have failed.

- Our values: Excellence keeps score. Integrity does what it says. Resourcefulness loves constraints.





About the Role

You are our all-rounder. You will write across every digital asset we publish and support content creation for Instagram, our
 newsletters, website assets, and
 ads. You will work within an established team of 15+ people, writing in our founder's clinical voice, not your own. If writing as someone else threatens your ego, stop reading here.





The Couple You Will Write For



You write in our founder's voice. You write for our patients: a couple more than two years into trying to conceive, usually closer to four, and theirs is a complex case. They reach us from the United States, Australia, or Europe, often also failed treatment, miscarriage, or both, and they have often been told, "everything looks normal." She is 39, and she leads this: she has done the research, she can usually name her own test results, she found us, and she brought him. He is in it just as deeply, but it shows differently. He will usually leave the treatment decisions to her because he has seen what each negative pregnancy test or loss has taken from her, and he is deathly afraid, even when he won't say it, of what more of it will do to her. And to them. Yet, like her, they know no one has assembled the full picture to identify the obstacles preventing them from holding their baby. They do not need convincing that something is wrong. They want someone competent enough to find it and help them change it, and they are on the same page, ready to do what it takes.



They are exhausted and have been sold hope and false solutions by others, so your job is not to persuade. It is to bring compelling clarity into what is already a noisy conversation full of uncertainty and unknowns: the voice of a team that has done this work well and reproducibly for more than two decades. Every statistic carries its citation. Clinical experience is never dressed up as a promise. The writing does not push. It makes the work unmistakable, so they recognize what they have been looking for.



We are not here for everyone struggling to have a baby. We do incredible work for the people who value our expertise and proven track record, and your copy is written to find them, not convince them.





What You Will Do

- Instagram. Carousels, captions, scripts, and Stories copy.

-
. Our newsletters, plus sequences across launches, nurture, and segmented sends.

- Web and funnel. Website and landing page copy, congruent from ad through to page, all the way through to clinical delivery handouts.

-
 ads. Distinct creative angles each refresh cycle: separate reasons to click, not variations on one hook.

- Creation stories. Patient story content, with every claim verified against source records before publication.

- Brand voice. Own and maintain the voice and style guide.

- Compliance rewrites. Own the rephrase when a platform rejects an ad on health claims policy.





What Success Looks Like

- Copy that converts. Every claim in it holds up to scrutiny.

- Delivered as promised. On the date you said, at consistent quality, across every channel.

- Angles we hadn't considered. Built to connect with the one woman and couple we are here to serve. They outperform the ones we had, and then you outperform your own best.

- Trust at the top. Our founder trusts what reaches her desk, because you caught the problems first.





Who You Are

- Persuasive, compelling, accurate, and consistent. You are dependable. You do what you say you will do.

- A clear, strategic thinker. You write from the shoes of the woman we serve.

- A proven deliverer. Hungry, innovative, and full of ideas, and every idea comes attached to shipped work and a result you can point to.

- A self-starter. You manage yourself. You need a clear brief and room to work, not reminding or chasing.

- A direct response writer. You know the difference between copy that reads well and copy that sells.

- Evidence literate. You can read a study and represent it correctly, and you would never blur "associated with" into "causes" to make a line land harder.

- A team player who wants a long-term career, with real progression, doing work that helps people. This is not a side gig or a stepping stone.





Core Skills and Qualifications

- 5+ years of professional copywriting experience. Portfolio required, and results outweigh tenure.

- Demonstrated direct response work across
, advertising, and sales or landing pages

- Experience writing in a brand or founder voice defined by someone else, within a style guide

- Ability to read primary research and represent it accurately, uncertainty included

- Excellent English, written and verbal, with precise control of register

- Bonus: regulated health writing, Meta health claims policy, women’s health writing background, or editing AI output to a publishable standard





What You Will Love About Working With Us

- Fully remote, location open. We hire the best person, wherever they are.

- Full-time, long-term career. Compensation and benefits aligned to your location, experience, skills, and results.

- Professional growth. Take ownership and build your career with a world-class, mission-driven team.

- Flexible, high-performance culture. Clear communication, personal responsibility, and mutual respect.

- Work with purpose. Words that reach people at the hardest point of their lives and give them something true to hold on to.



How to Apply



Apply here: 



Please include:



- Your resume

- A cover letter explaining why you are the right fit

- A portfolio of your best direct response work:
, advertising, and sales or landing pages



Important: In your cover letter, link the one piece of writing you are most proud of and tell us why. What was the brief? What decision did you make that another writer might not have, and how did it perform?



Only applications that follow these instructions will be considered. Yes, that is a test.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid trial task, written to a brief and a supplied voice guide.



Join a team that expects greatness and helps you achieve yours.

title: Marketing and Operations Manager (Right Hand) for DTC ecom Brand - $1,500+ USD Monthly
description:
Stop scrolling through mediocre opportunities. This isn't another "marketing and operations manager needed" post.



We need ONE brilliant, hard-working mind to train into our next marketing leader.



We're an 8-figure DTC health & wellness eCommerce brand - and we're looking for one sharp, organized person to grow with us for years.



Most job posts want a specialist. We want a mind we can trust.



Here's the truth: we can teach you everything you need to know. Marketing, media buying, copywriting, funnel building, conversion optimization - all of it. What we can't teach is how to think. How to stay organized. How to work hard and figure things out without being told twice.



So if you're smart, driven, and hungry to learn - even if you're not a marketing expert yet - keep reading. That's exactly what we're hiring for.



- The Position: Marketing & Operations Manager (Trained Into Hands-On CMO)

- The Company: 8-figure DTC health & wellness eCommerce brand (50% Germany, 50% USA)

- The Niche: Sleep, pain relief, and health products that genuinely change lives

- Location: 100% Remote

- Compensation: $1,500/month to start - with no ceiling, really. It goes as far as you take it.



What You'll Actually Be Doing



This is primarily a hands-on marketing role - with a heavy focus on writing. But you'll also help us build structure, sharpen processes, and grow our team as we scale. You'll be our right hand across the business.



Don't worry if some of this is new. As you learn, you'll take on more. Here's what your weeks will eventually look like:



- Writing scripts, ads, and copy using proven Direct Response principles (this is core - you must love writing)

- Optimizing conversion rates and running A/B tests that move real numbers

- Bringing structure and processes into how we run marketing

- Overseeing video editors - reviewing their work, giving revisions, keeping quality high

- Editing funnels with drag-and-drop tools

- Media buying across Meta & Google Ads

- Product testing using our internal templates

- Helping build the team as we grow



The first weeks and months have one goal: learn as much as humanly possible.



The end goal: you become a core operator we rely on completely.



Why This Role Is Different



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone to invest in - and build with for the long haul.



You'll be personally trained by us - an 8-figure founding team:



- Copywriting (Scripts, Advertorials, VSLs, Native Ads)

- Media Buying (Meta & Google Ads)

This is a paid education worth more than any MBA. You don't need to walk in knowing all of this - you need to be the kind of person who can learn it fast.



Who We're Actually Looking For



Read this carefully, because it matters far more than your résumé:



- You're genuinely smart. You learn fast and connect dots others miss. This is the #1 thing we care about.

- You're a strong writer. Your English is flawless, and you genuinely enjoy writing. Non-negotiable.

- You're organized. You bring order to chaos. Systems and processes come naturally to you.

- You work hard. Not "I show up" hard - "I obsess over getting it right" hard.

- You're independent. You don't wait to be told what to do. You find the work and do it.

- You're loyal. You want to grow WITH a company. We have huge plans for the next few years, and we want someone who wants to be part of that story.



We've hired brilliant people from all kinds of backgrounds. What matters most is that you're sharp, driven, and already know your way around the eCommerce or online marketing world.



If you need hand-holding, this isn't for you. If you want to plant roots and build something real, keep reading.



Minimum Requirements

- You've worked at an online marketing agency OR an eCommerce brand. This is a must - you already understand how this world works. (Whatever your exact role was - marketing, ops, organization, assistant - we're open.)

- Fluent, exceptional English - you write clearly and persuasively

- Comfortable with tools like Shopify, Canva, and social media (you don't need to be an expert - just comfortable and quick to learn)

- You use AI daily (Claude / ChatGPT) - not occasionally

- Fluent with modern tools (Slack, Notion, and whatever's new)

- Notice what's NOT here: years of deep marketing experience. That's what we'll teach you. We care far more about raw intelligence and work ethic than a perfect track record.



Why This Changes Your Life



For the right person, this isn't a job. It's a partnership. You start at $1,500/month, but for hard workers who prove themselves, there's no ceiling. As we grow, you grow. As the brand grows into a portfolio, so does your role - and your income.



We're looking for ONE person. A long-term partner. Someone we can pour knowledge into and build the next chapter with.



How to Apply



Keep it short and to the point. We only want three things:



1.) Your background: Did you work at an online marketing agency or an eCommerce brand? Tell us your role and what you actually accomplished.



2.) Largest team: What's the biggest team you've managed or coordinated?



3.) Motivation: What makes you want THIS role, long-term?



No long essays. Just the essentials, clearly written.



We read every application personally. Show us you're the one.



Application tip: Show, don't tell. Specific examples beat generic statements.



We're hiring ONE person for a long-term partnership. Quality applications only

title: VIP Client Support Associate
description:
We're building a remote VIP Support team for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for people we can grow from the ground up — not just workers, but the kind of people who take genuine pride in doing things right. This role blends support with relationship-building: you won't just resolve client concerns, you'll also learn to spot the right 
nts to introduce clients to more of what we offer.



This is not a call center role. You'll be managing real relationships with high-value clients — providing support, but also recognizing opportunities to grow those relationships — and holding yourself to a high standard on every single interaction. Our clients are VIPs — quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and work out the correct response on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for judgment. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the processes, tools, and structure you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want people who take initiative to help shape them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Handle inbound client inquiries via messaging platforms with care and thoroughness

• Recognize natural opportunities within conversations to introduce clients to relevant features, promotions, or products that genuinely add value to them

• Use our drafting tool to sharpen your own well-considered responses for supervisor review — the tool supports your judgment; it doesn't replace it

• Keep thorough, accurate track of each client's concerns and history — nothing gets forgotten, nothing falls through the cracks

• Escalate immediately to your Lead when handling an irate or escalating client — do not attempt to resolve it alone

• Maintain detailed and accurate client interaction logs

• Follow team rules, protocols, and procedures diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every client interaction is a once-in-a-lifetime encounter that deserves your full presence and care.



What We're Looking For:



• Early career — fresh graduates welcome, but you need real client-facing experience (internship, part-time work, thesis project, VA work, or similar counts)

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, 
s, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you speak up, express yourself clearly, and don't go quiet when things get uncomfortable

• Understands hierarchy — you know when to handle something yourself and when to bring it to your Lead, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — you track every detail, follow through, and take full ownership of every client you handle

• Relationship-minded — you can naturally spot opportunities to add value for a client, not just resolve their immediate issue

• Follows rules diligently — protocols aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a client's situation yourself, not just reword what a tool gives you

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll be handling sensitive VIP information

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• Holds a TESDA BPO NC II certification

• HubSpot or Zendesk Customer Service certification

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level fluency — especially valuable if you can review Japanese-language drafts for tone and accuracy

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products

• Experience in sales, account management, upselling, or client retention

• Has handled foreign or executive-level clients before



Reporting to: VIP Support Lead and Growth Operations Lead



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• 8 AM–4 PM Philippine Time (JST business hours) to start, 5 days/week — this window may extend depending on client traffic and business needs, so come in with realistic expectations around hours

• No time tracker

• Overtime available as needed and subject to supervisor approval

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — stable fiber internet required

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you handle any client information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status, working full 8-hour days, running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your performance is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[VIP Support] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then answer all three questions below. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. You're handling five VIP clients at the same time. One sends you a voice note. One sends a 
 with no context. One hasn't replied in 3 days and suddenly needs urgent help. One says "???" and one says "never mind." Walk us through your exact next 10 minutes.

2. If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

3. Think of a time you were part of a startup or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?



A note on AI: using it to help you write is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it. Edit before you submit.



Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language.



Applications without the correct subject line and all three answers will not be reviewed.

title: Facebook Ads Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products in the health and wellness niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UG-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING —



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- AI voiceover ads: A simple combination of voiceover and b-rolls, chosen carefully and enhanced with copy, graphic and sound effects, zooms, transitions, etc.

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around

education and direct-response structure

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after 
nts, and social proof

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



— WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR —



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to edit videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes... then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



— THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE —



You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



— SKILLS & EXPERIENCE —



Ideally, you have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- ??Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with in the health and wellness niche.



— WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY —



- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



— WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU —



- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively



How to Apply:

To apply, simply fill out this Google Form: 

We will review all submissions and contact the shortlisted candidates via

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Brand Manager - Amazon Private Label | 3+ Years Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across the US, CA, UK, EU, AU and JP, and expanding into Saudi Arabia — two brands (travel accessories and beauty devices), 52+ active SKUs. We're moving from a founder-run business to a systems-run one, and this role owns the commercial result.



The Role

This is commercial ownership, not task execution. You own the P&L, the launches and the positioning for both brands, and you make the day-to-day commercial calls that today land on the founders' desk. You report to the two Founders.



If you need to be told what to do each day, this isn't for you. If you read a portfolio yourself, commit to a decision and defend it with numbers rather than hand it back - read on.



What You'll Own

- The P&L at ASIN level across both brands and every marketplace — built by you, after fees, ads, returns and storage.

- A quarterly kill / hold / invest call on every product, and a weekly report to the founders.

- Every launch end to end, from the pre-launch gate to the scale-or-stop decision.

- Positioning, SEO / keywords, and PPC to agreed TACOS / ROAS targets.

- Diagnosing underperformance — traffic, conversion, price, reviews and product each need a different fix.

- Final approval on creative, copy and packaging before it publishes or prints — judged on conversion, not taste.

- What we build next, together with R&D.



Where the Founders Stay Involved

The Founders own the big bets - company direction, new markets and brands, budgets, margin targets, salaries, hiring and large investments. Everything commercial below that line is yours to run, and you're trusted to make the call without waiting to be asked.



Tools You Should Know

- Amazon Seller Central (Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, business reports) · 

- Amazon Ads · Helium 10 / Keepa · 

- Google Sheets (P&L models you build yourself) · 

- ClickUp, 

- Slack, 

- Drive.



Who We're Looking For

- 3+ years managing Amazon FBA brands accountable for the commercial result, not just execution.

- Strong, hands-on Amazon: you read Brand Analytics, SQP and business reports, and build your own P&L models in a spreadsheet.

- At least one full launch you can talk through end to end — including what went wrong.

- You've directed PPC against a target you owned.

- You bring a recommendation with the numbers attached, and you'll tell us an uncomfortable truth rather than sit on it.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- DTC / website experience alongside the marketplace is a plus.



Commercial ownership starts on day one, and the role is built to grow toward leadership.



Compensation & Setup

- $1,600–$2,000/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week, remote

- 14 days paid leave per year

- Long-term position — we invest in people who invest in us





To Apply - Required



Answer only from your own experience. Every answer must name a real company from your CV and use real numbers from that business. We're not asking what you would do - we're asking what you actually did. Hypothetical or generic answers (including AI-written ones) will not move forward: 



1. Take one product you owned at a company on your CV. Walk us through its real unit economics - price, landed cost, Amazon fees, ad spend, return rate - and one decision you made because of those numbers.

2. Walk us through one launch you ran, at a named company - from PO to the scale-or-stop call. What was the plan, and what went wrong?

3. A product's sales fell at a company on your CV. What did you check, in what order - and what did you find and d
?

4. A listing, image or piece of copy you changed or refused to publish - what was wrong, what did you change, and what happened to sales after?



Please include your salary expectation and availability.

title: Client-Facing AI Systems & Automation Engineer
description:
Client-Facing AI Systems & Automation Engineer, Remote



We are Asterley Bros, a growing craft drinks business based in London. We make British vermouth, amaro, cocktails, and aperitivo products, selling through ecommerce, trade, events, distributors, and Amazon.



We are looking for a reliable, technically strong, client-facing engineer to help us build and support AI-enabled systems for both our own business and our Absolution Labs clients.



This is not a pure coding role. You will need to understand business problems, communicate clearly with non-technical people, train users, troubleshoot issues, and build systems that people actually use.



You should be comfortable moving between:



- building Python scripts, integrations, and AI workflows;

- joining client calls;

- listening carefully to what a client is really trying to achieve;

- explaining technical ideas in simple language;

- writing clear documentation;

- troubleshooting when something is not working;

- improving systems based on user feedback.



If you are technically strong but do not enjoy explaining, training, and supporting non-technical users, this is probably not the right role.



About us



Asterley Bros is a London-based craft drinks company. We make premium British vermouth, amaro, cocktails, and aperitivo products.





We are building practical AI-enabled operating systems, not demos. The goal is to create tools and workflows that save time, improve visibility, and help real businesses run better.



What you’ll do



You will work across internal Asterley Bros systems and client projects.



Your work may include:



- Mapping business workflows with our team or clients

- Building AI-enabled automations and integrations

- Creating internal tools, dashboards, approval flows, and reporting systems

- Integrating with tools such as Shopify, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, CRMs, Xero,
, and internal documents

- Building and maintaining Python scripts, APIs, and lightweight web tools

- Reviewing, testing, and improving AI-generated code

- Setting up logging, monitoring, and simple health checks

- Troubleshooting bugs, failed automations, broken integrations, and data issues

- Writing clear documentation and user guides

- Training non-technical users on how to use the systems

- Joining client calls to gather requirements, explain solutions, and support implementation



A typical project might be:



- Turning a manual spreadsheet process into an automated workflow

- Connecting Shopify, Google Sheets,
, and CRM data into one useful dashboard

- Building a tool that drafts customer or sales follow-ups for human approval

- Helping a client understand why an automation is failing and fixing it

- Training a client team to use a new AI-assisted workflow

- Reviewing AI-generated code, improving it, testing it, and deploying it safely

- Creating a simple dashboard or admin tool that non-technical users can actually understand



Client communication is a core part of the role



This is very important.



You must be able to communicate clearly with non-technical business users. Some of our clients will not know exactly what they need. You will need to listen carefully, ask good questions, and help translate their problems into practical technical solutions.



We are looking for someone who can:



- Listen well before jumping to a technical answer

- Ask clear, practical questions

- Explain technical issues in plain English

- Stay calm and helpful when troubleshooting problems

- Train clients patiently and clearly

- Write simple step-by-step instructions

- Tell us early when something is blocked, risky, or unclear

- Communicate progress without needing to be chased

- Be honest about what is possible, what is not, and what needs more investigation



If you prefer to only receive tickets and code alone, this is probably not the right role.



How we expect you to work with AI



We use AI tools heavily, and we expect this role to do the same.



This is not about using ChatGPT occasionally. We are looking for someone whose normal working cadence reflects modern AI-assisted software development.



You should be comfortable using AI coding tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar every day to move faster on:



- boilerplate code

- API integrations

- tests

- documentation

- debugging

- refactoring

- code review

- implementation planning



We expect AI to increase your speed and output compared with a traditional hand-coding workflow. Modern AI tools remove a lot of slow boilerplate work, and we expect you to use them well.



But speed alone is not enough.



You are still responsible for the final result. You must understand the code, test it, review it, handle edge cases, protect secrets, and make sure the system is reliable and maintainable.



We do not want someone who blindly copies AI-generated code. We also do not want someone who works as if AI tools do not exist.



The right person will use AI as a serious productivity multiplier while applying strong engineering judgement.



What we expect technically



Required:



- Strong Python for scripting, APIs, automation, and backend workflows

- Experience consuming and building REST APIs

- Good understanding of authentication, API keys, OAuth, webhooks, error handling, and retries

- Comfortable working with JSON, CSV, spreadsheets, and structured data

- Experience with SQL or database-backed applications

- Git and GitHub workflow

- Basic cloud or server deployment experience

- Ability to test, debug, and maintain your own work

- Ability to write clear documentation for technical and non-technical users



Strong pluses:



- JavaScript or TypeScript

- Docker

- FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar

- Google Workspace APIs, especially Sheets and Drive

- Shopify API

- Xero API

- CRM integrations

-
 integrations, IMAP/SMTP or Microsoft/Google APIs

- Firebase, Supabase, Postgres, or similar

- Simple web dashboards or admin tools

- Experience supporting clients or external users



AI and LLM experience



You should have hands-on experience using LLM APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or similar.



You should understand:



- Prompt design for real workflows

- Structured outputs, JSON schemas, and validation

- Tool calling or agent workflows

- Human approval gates

- How to constrain AI systems so they do not act unsafely

- How to evaluate and test AI outputs

- How to monitor failures and avoid silent errors

- Why AI-generated code still needs proper review, testing, and security checks



Experience with agent frameworks is useful, but not required if you are strong technically and understand the principles.



The mindset we want



This role needs someone who is:



- Reliable

- Detail-oriented

- A good listener

- A clear communicator

- Patient with non-technical users

- Comfortable with ambiguity

- Honest about what is working and what is not

- Good at asking questions

- Able to work independently

- Careful with sensitive business and client data

- Interested in building systems that real people use

- Willing to improve and maintain existing systems, not only build new things

- Fast-moving, but not reckless

- Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of their normal engineering workflow



We are not looking for someone who only wants to build exciting demos. We need someone who can help us create practical AI-enabled systems for real businesses.



Role details



- Location: Fully remote

- Company: Asterley Bros London, UK

- Type: Part-time or project-based to start, with potential to grow

- Hours: Flexible, but you must be able to overlap with UK working hours for part of the day

- Compensation: Competitive for the Philippines market, based on experience and ability

- Start: As soon as possible for the right person



How to apply



We receive a high volume of generic AI-written applications. Please read this section carefully.



Applications that look like generic ChatGPT cover letters, do not answer the questions below, or are not specific to this role will be ignored.



To apply, please send:



1. Your CV or resume

2. Your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of previous work

3. A short 3 to 5 minute Loom video, or similar screen-recorded video

4. Short written answers to the questions below



Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



Please start your application message with this exact sentence:



'I build systems people actually use'



In your video, please answer:



- Why are you interested in this role?

- Tell us about one automation, integration, or internal tool you have built. What problem did it solve, what tools or APIs did it use, and what was hard about it?

- Tell us about a time you had to explain a technical issue to a non-technical client, manager, or teammate.

- How do you use AI coding tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar?

- Give one example where AI helped you build something faster than you could have by hand. What did you delegate to AI, what did you personally d
, and how did you verify the result?

- How do you check whether AI-generated code is safe, reliable, and correct?



In your written answers, please answer briefly:



- What is your expected hourly or monthly rate?

- What hours can you regularly overlap with the UK working day?

- What are the main APIs, tools, or platforms you have integrated with before?

- If an automation fails in production, what are the first things you check?

- What parts of engineering should not be delegated blindly to AI?



Please do not send a long generic cover letter. A short, specific application is much better.



Generic applications will be ignored. We are looking for someone who has read the role properly and can show that they understand both the technical and client-facing parts of the job.
