Troubleshooting basic invoice and payment issues

Maintaining accurate patient financial records

Assisting with payment workflows and automations



QuickBooks & Bookkeeping

*Experience with QuickBooks Online and bookkeeping is required*



Responsibilities may include:

Setting up and managing Chart of Accounts

Categorizing business transactions

Reviewing income and expenses

Matching payments and deposits

Reconciling bank and credit card accounts

Identifying duplicate, missing, or incorrectly categorized transactions

Maintaining organized bookkeeping records

Preparing basic financial reports or spreadsheets as requested

Helping ensure my books are organized and ready for review by my CPA



You will not be replacing my CPA. I am looking for someone who can help keep the day-to-day bookkeeping accurate and organized.



This is NOT primarily a social media or marketing position.

Experience with Canva, newsletters, social media, content creation, or digital marketing is a bonus, but billing, bookkeeping, and financial organization are the priority.



YOU WOULD BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Have hands-on Medicare Part B billing experience

Have personally submitted medical claims

Have experience correcting rejected claims and working denials

Understand the claims process from submission through payment

Have strong attention to detail

Are highly organized

Follow through until problems are actually resolved

Are comfortable independently researching billing issues

Take initiative instead of waiting for detailed instructions for every task

Have excellent written and spoken English

Can clearly explain problems and proposed solutions

Are comfortable working with financial information

Understand the importance of patient confidentiality

Are reliable and consistent

Want a long-term position with a growing medical practice



YOU ARE PROBABLY NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

Have healthcare VA experience but have never personally submitted insurance claims

Have no Medicare billing experience

Need step-by-step instructions for every task

Frequently leave tasks unfinished without follow-up

Struggle with attention to detail

Are uncomfortable troubleshooting rejected or denied claims

Have difficulty managing multiple small tasks independently

Simply report that something “doesn't work” without attempting to identify the cause or solution



SOFTWARE & EXPERIENCE

Required:

Medicare Part B billing experience

Healthcare/medical office experience

QuickBooks Online



Strongly Preferred:

CharmHealth / CharmEHR

GoHighLevel



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer

Webcam and microphone for Google Meet

Ability to securely access healthcare systems

Availability for meetings during U.S. Eastern Time



HEALTHCARE & PRIVACY

Because you will have access to confidential patient and financial information:

HIPAA compliance is mandatory

Strict patient confidentiality is required

You must be comfortable working with medical terminology

Financial information must be handled carefully and confidentially

HIPAA training will be provided as needed



HOURS & SCHEDULE

Part-time, Approximately 5–10 hours per week

100% remote

Schedule can be flexible depending on responsibilities

Weekly or scheduled Google Meet check-ins as needed

Performance review after the initial 1-month probationary period

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

I am looking for someone who can eventually become my go-to person for billing and financial administrative workflows, and grow wants to grow with the practice long-term.



HOW TO APPLY

Include your previous healthcare, billing, bookkeeping, and virtual assistant experience.

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
Job Summary



The Credentialing Specialist will manage, verify, and maintain the professional licenses, certifications, and insurance network enrollments for healthcare client accounts. This role acts as a primary source verification agent, ensuring that all healthcare providers meet strict regulatory, state, federal, and payer compliance requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proficient at navigating insurance applications and government portals.



Core Responsibilities



Primary Source Verification: Validate provider licensures, certifications, board credentials, education, and work history.

Application Processing: Complete and submit high-volume enrollment applications for government (Medicare, Medicaid) and commercial payers.



Database Maintenance: Update and maintain precise data fields across CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and internal software.



Expiration Tracking: Proactively monitor provider expiration dates for DEA, state licenses, and malpractice insurance.

Discrepancy Resolution: Identify potential onboarding delays, research missing file documentation, and resolve issues.



Payer Follow-Up: Contact Managed Care Organizations (MCOs) and commercial plans regularly to track application statuses.



Audit Support: Assist in preparing required provider files and scoring checklists for accreditation reviews and audits.

Client Communication: Serve as a primary point of contact for providers, medical staff offices, and client leadership.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate or Bachelor's degree preferred.



Experience: Minimum 1–3 years of direct healthcare credentialing or medical provider enrollment experience.



Technical Skills: Proficiency using specialized credentialing software (Credentialing Spectrum) and Google Sheets, Google Drive, FrontAPP



Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and state licensing board requirements.



Data Integrity: Extreme attention to detail with an exceptionally low error rate in high-volume data entry.



Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills for interacting with providers and insurance companies.



Confidentiality: Demonstrated capability to securely manage and process highly sensitive, confidential personal data.



Preferred Certifications

Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) through NAMSS.

Certified Professional Medical Services Management (CPMSM).

title: Logistics Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



This role sits inside a global logistics technology company that helps e-commerce brands streamline international fulfillment. As Logistics Operations Manager, you own the daily playbooks that keep freight moving on schedule and inventory accurate, coordinating with freight brokers, reconciling inventory on receipt, ensuring timely warehouse inbounding, and applying sound judgment on the roughly 10% of daily operations that fall outside standard procedure. You are embedded directly with a growth-stage business and leadership team who need a technically strong, independent operator, with ongoing coaching, clear standards, and a dedicated Success Manager behind you so you can focus on doing excellent work.

This is a dedicated, full-time role designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth in logistics and cross-border operations.



Responsibilities

• Execute daily logistics operations playbooks, applying independent judgment on the estimated 10% of cases that fall outside standard procedure

• Source and compare freight brokerage quotes, balancing delivery timelines against cost to secure the best option for each shipment

• Coordinate directly with freight brokers to confirm bookings, track shipments in transit, and resolve delays

• Reconcile inventory upon receipt, verifying quantities and condition against purchase orders and manifests

• Ensure timely warehouse inbounding, coordinating with warehouse teams to prevent processing bottlenecks

• Review commercial invoices for accuracy on cross-border shipments before they move forward

• Apply working knowledge of HS codes to classify shipments correctly and avoid customs delays

• Maintain accurate records in internal operations tools and calculators used for daily decision-making

• Flag discrepancies, delays, or exceptions to the appropriate internal team promptly and clearly

• Support ad hoc logistics projects and process improvements as the business scales

• Adapt quickly as priorities shift, maintaining dependable throughput across all daily operational tasks



Qualifications

• Background in logistics, freight, or e-commerce operations (must-have)

• Working understanding of HS codes and customs classification (must-have)

• Familiarity with commercial invoices and cross-border shipping documentation (must-have)

• Ability to run daily operational playbooks independently, exercising judgment where needed (must-have)

• Strong attention to detail and consistent, dependable daily throughput (must-have)

• Comfortable coordinating directly with freight brokers and vendors (must-have)

• Experience with inventory reconciliation processes preferred

• Experience with internal ops software, calculators, or WMS platforms preferred



Tools You'll Use

• Freight and Logistics: freight brokerage coordination and quoting systems (must-have)

• Trade Documentation: HS code references and commercial invoice systems (must-have)

• Inventory: warehouse and inventory reconciliation tools (must-have)

• Internal Systems: company operations tools and calculators (must-have), plus WMS platforms where available



Benefits

• Competitive salary

• Paid US holidays

• Paid wellness days

• Health and wellness allowance

• Monthly profit sharing

• Long-term placement with real growth

• Continuous upskilling in AI and logistics operations

• Dedicated success coaching and support

title: Organic Content Marketer
description:
About



This role owns how the client side of the company shows up in public: content, organic social,
, and the founder's voice. It lives in social, not adjacent to it. There is no ad budget to hide behind, which means the work either connects or it doesn't, and you'll know quickly either way.

In exchange you get real creative control, collaboration with a small team, and your fingerprints visible on everything, plugged into a company that places vetted remote operators with founder-led and small businesses across finance, healthcare, legal, tech, startup, and property management.

This is dedicated, full-time work designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth. You'll have the runway to build a body of public work with your name attached, backed by a team that treats craft as the point rather than the afterthought.



Responsibilities

•	Capture attention: Craft hooks, first frames, and first lines that are native to each platform, never one asset cross-posted four ways.

•	Keep attention: Build series over one-offs and formats people start looking for, optimizing for retention, saves, and returns rather than just reach.

•	Nurture attention: Work the comments, DMs,
, and community; know when a thread should become a conversation and make that feel like a favor rather than a funnel.

•	Create content end to end: Write it, shoot it, cut it, ship it across carousels, short-form video, long-form posts, case studies, and one-pagers, so it reads like a human made it on purpose.

•	Publish weekly blog content alongside a consistent social rhythm, then live in the comments with trend judgment, platform-native formats, and same-day replies.

•	Run
 marketing and nurture: Build sequences that read like a person, not a CRM. You'll inherit a template system and brand kit, and you're welcome to break both and rebuild them better.

•	Own LinkedIn, podcast, PR, and media: Ghostwrite and produce for the founder and team leads, book guests, cut clips, and pitch placements, making other people sound like themselves.

•	Manage client and partner marketing: Take partnerships from "we should do something together" to launched, including angle, assets, copy, landing page, and launch post, so collaborations ship instead of dying in a thread.

•	Support business development: Turn around decks, one-pagers, proposal polish, and co-marketing quickly with taste intact.

•	In the first 90 days: learn the client side from the inside (brand, ICP, messaging), lock a publishing rhythm with two or three formats, and take full ownership of the hero platform and its metrics.



Qualifications

•	You reverse-engineer why a post worked, unprompted, for fun (must-have)

•	You can hit publish on something you're only 80% sure about (must-have)

•	You'd rather try seven things and kill four than perfect one

•	You'd rather answer 40 comments than sit in one more meeting

•	You have loud opinions about which formats are overdone right now

•	You want your work in public with your name attached to it (must-have)

•	Trends are not an afterthought, but ideas you thrive on

•	You're strong in two or three of the responsibility areas above and genuinely curious about the rest (must-have)

•	You treat AI as a critical part of how you produce, iterate, and ship (must-have)

•	Comfort operating with autonomy, setting the rhythm rather than waiting for a brief (must-have)

•	Paid media experience is not required; this role is organic-first on purpose

•	No degree, agency pedigree, or minimum tenure required; your own follower count is not what's being evaluated



Tools You'll Use

title: Experienced GoHighLevel Specialist – CRM, AI, Automations & Funnels
description:
Starting Pay: $7.00 USD/hour — NON-NEGOTIABLE

IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER OR ENTRY-LEVEL GHL POSITION.



We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to become a key technical resource for multiple home improvement and lead-generation businesses.



Please do not apply if you are currently learning GoHighLevel, have only basic experience building funnels, or require step-by-step instructions for normal GHL functions.



We need someone who already understands GHL well enough to build, troubleshoot, research, test and solve problems independently.



The starting rate for this position is $7.00 USD per hour. This starting rate is firm and is not negotiable. Please do not apply asking for a higher starting rate.



What We Need



This is much more than a funnel-building position.



We need someone capable of handling the technical side of our GoHighLevel infrastructure and eventually taking significant ownership over our CRM, automations, AI systems and funnels.



You should have strong working knowledge of:



GHL CRM setup and management

Advanced workflows and automations

Pipelines and opportunities

Custom fields, tags and contact management

Calendars and appointment scheduling

Lead routing and qualification

GHL Voice AI

GHL Conversation AI/chatbots

AI prompts and knowledge bases

Phone numbers and call routing

SMS and
 automations

Forms, surveys and chat widgets

Funnels and landing pages

 and Google lead 

Tracking and attribution

Webhooks and third-party integrations

User access and GHL configuration

Troubleshooting existing GHL systems

Testing systems before they are deployed



Experience with Zapier, Make, APIs, webhooks, JavaScript or custom integrations is a major advantage.



The Level of Independence We Expect



We will sometimes provide extremely detailed instructions. Other times, you will be given an objective and expected to determine the technical solution.



For example, we may say:



“Build an after-hours AI receptionist that qualifies incoming callers, determines their service area and schedules them into the appropriate calendar.”



An experienced candidate should be capable of determining how to build the system, researching anything necessary, configuring it, testing different scenarios, identifying problems and presenting a working solution.



We are not looking for someone who stops working every time they encounter something they haven't done before.



We understand that nobody knows every feature of GoHighLevel. Research is completely acceptable and encouraged. What matters is your ability to find answers, troubleshoot problems and continue making progress independently.



If something genuinely requires administrator access or additional permissions, we expect you to identify specifically what is required and communicate it clearly.



AI & Automation



AI will be an increasingly important part of this position.



We are building systems involving:



Voice AI • Conversation AI • Automated Scheduling • Lead Qualification • CRM Automation • Automated Follow-Up • Knowledge Bases • Call Handling • Lead Routing



You should either already have strong experience with GHL's AI tools or be highly capable of working with them.



Our goal isn't simply to have AI features turned on. We want AI systems that actually work reliably with real customers.



That means testing different customer scenarios, finding weaknesses in the conversation flow and continuously improving the system.



Funnels & Lead Generation



You should also be capable of building professional, conversion-focused GHL funnels and landing pages.



Our businesses generate leads through Google,
 and other marketing channels, so these pages need to do more than look attractive.



You should understand mobile-first design, calls to action, lead capture, conversion flow, social proof, trust building, chat integration, tracking and responsive design.



We operate primarily in the home improvement and lead-generation industries, so experience with contractors or home-service businesses is a plus.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



Experienced. Technical. Resourceful. Reliable. Organized. Detail-oriented.



Most importantly, we want someone who can take ownership of a project.



When you encounter a problem, your first instinct should be to investigate it and determine the solution—not simply wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



At the same time, good communication is extremely important. If something requires information, access or a business decision from us, communicate exactly what you need.



Compensation



Starting pay: $7.00 USD per hour.



The starting rate is NON-NEGOTIABLE.



Please only apply if you are comfortable beginning at $7/hour.



We are looking for someone interested in establishing a long-term working relationship and taking on greater responsibility as our systems continue to grow.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



How many years/months have you actively worked inside GoHighLevel?

What would you rate your GHL knowledge from 1–10, and why?

Describe the most technically advanced GHL system you have personally built.

Describe your experience with GHL Voice AI.

Describe your experience with Conversation AI and AI knowledge bases.

What types of GHL workflows and automations have you built?

Have you worked with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make or custom code? Explain.

Send examples of GHL funnels you personally built.

Send a Loom video showing us inside a GHL account or system you personally built and explain how it works.

What hours are you available to work in Eastern Time (US)?

Confirm in your application: “I understand the starting rate is $7.00 USD/hour and I am comfortable with this rate.”



Applications that do not answer the questions above may not be considered.



Please Do Not Apply If:



You are brand new to GoHighLevel, are currently taking a course to learn GHL, have primarily worked as a general VA, only know basic funnel/page building, or need extensive training before you can independently manage GHL projects.



We are hiring someone because we need GHL expertise on our team—not someone we need to teach GoHighLevel from the beginning.

/SMS, ambassador programs, and UGC as one integrated growth system. We are growing and need a sharp, organized person to own our client relationships and keep every account on track.



What you'll do

You are the person who keeps each apparel client's growth on schedule and their paid ads profitable, week after week. Specifically:



- **Run the weekly review.** Pull each client's Meta and Google numbers, compare against their breakeven, and assess whether the account is healthy. Flag problems early.

- **Own the drop calendar.** Apparel brands launch product "drops." You make sure
/SMS flows are queued, creative is ready, and the media buyer has what they need, so nothing slips before a launch.

- **Be the client's main point of contact.** Weekly check-ins, clear updates, answering questions, handling the small things so they never become big things.

- **Check the media buyer's work.** You won't build campaigns, but you must catch when spend is off or performance is slipping and raise it before the client notices.

- **Escalate the right things.** Handle routine calls yourself using our playbook. Bring the real judgment calls to the founder, packaged and ready to d
.



You must have

- **Strong English, written and spoken.** You'll be on client calls and writing client updates. Both need to be crisp. This is non-negotiable.

- **Comfort with ad numbers.** You can read a week of Meta data, understand a breakeven number, and check a buyer's work. You don't need to be a world-class buyer, but you must speak their language.

- **DTC apparel experience.** You already understand clothing brand funnels, offers, drop calendars, and
 flows. We are not teaching the category from scratch.

- **Great judgment.** You know the difference between a decision you can make and one that needs to go up the chain. You ask instead of guessing.

- **Coordinator instinct.** Organized, calendar-driven, and you follow up without being chased.



**Nice to have**

- Hands-on Meta or Google Ads experience

- Direct experience inside or with a DTC clothing brand

- Experience managing a small team



**Hours & pay**

- Full-time, must reliably overlap US Eastern business hours (this is a hard requirement, not occasional)

- Pay range: **$650–$1,250/month** depending on experience and ad literacy



**How to apply**

In your reply, do three things:

1. Start your message with the word **APPAREL** so I know you read this.

2. Tell me about one DTC clothing brand you've worked with and what you specifically did.

3. Answer this: *A client wants to kill a campaign in the middle of a drop. The last 7 days of Meta data are below breakeven, but the drop launches in 3 days. What do you do?*



Applications that skip the question or give a generic answer will not be considered.

title: Trade Operations Administrator
description:
About the Role



We're hiring a Trade Operations Administrator to run the daily rhythm of a maintenance and repair operation serving real estate agencies and their tenants across Queensland. This role sits at the center of a fast-moving trade office, working the inboxes, coordinating field staff, booking and confirming jobs, notifying tenants, and keeping KPI tracking current. You'll be the primary point of contact for tenants, agencies, and tradespeople throughout the day, keeping jobs moving and giving local leadership room to focus on the bigger picture.



This is a dedicated, full-time position built for meaningful impact, stability, and long-term growth. You'll own the operational heartbeat of the business, with training on our internal tools and a clear path to expand your responsibilities as trust builds.



Responsibilities



- Inbox management: Work the main
 inbox and enquiries inbox to zero at the start of the day, after lunch, and before sign-off. Enter new enquiries into Tradify and follow up on anything still open.

- Tenant communication: Answer tenant phone calls and text messages, and divert the work phone to the local team at the end of each day.

- Scheduling: Build the daily job schedule and assign jobs to the right tradesperson, then send entry notices to tenants ahead of scheduled work and confirmation
s for H&U and TBG jobs.

- Job readiness: Confirm every job carries the details the tradesperson needs before arriving, including quote instructions, job notes, whether the tenant will be home, lockbox codes, and any special order materials or equipment.

- Reschedules: Reschedule or cancel jobs when plans change, and text affected tenants the same day.

- Staff coordination: Call each tradesperson individually every morning to check how the day looks, flag urgent jobs, and catch problems early. Report back in the daily sync meeting with anything that needs a decision.

- Access and logistics: Arrange key pickups, lockbox codes, and tool collection with agencies and staff.

- Agency relationships:
 agencies about keys to be collected and lockbox codes. Call agencies about outstanding invoices and quotes, confirm payment dates, resend anything that went missing, and explain where pending quotes stand.

- Reporting and data: Update invoice, work order, and quote KPIs in the Real Estate Database and KPI sheet. Add new agencies, property managers, and
 addresses to the same database. KPI sheets should be current every Monday.

- Agency outreach: Run outreach
s to agencies by region using approved templates and BCC format.

- AI-assisted drafting: Use Claude AI to draft entry notices and routine
s, then review and approve each one before it goes out.

- End-of-day checklist: Sign off only after confirming both inboxes are empty, keys and lockbox codes are sorted and recorded in every job description, and any incomplete job has been rescheduled with the tenant texted.

- First 90 days: Both inboxes cleared three times a day without prompting, entry notices and job confirmations going out on schedule with no missed tenants, and scheduling and follow-up owned end-to-end.



Requirements



- Clear spoken and written English, as this role speaks with Australian tenants and property managers by phone every day (must-have)

- Comfortable making outbound calls to tenants, tradespeople, and agency staff (must-have)

- Follows a schedule and a checklist without being reminded, and flags immediately when something is behind (must-have)

title: Short-Form Video Editor, Reels + Graphics
description:
ABOUT US:

Havenroll is a marketing agency serving private Christian schools and other faith-based clients. We help schools reach and enroll families who align with their mission. We also handle video and social media for a handful of churches, nonprofits, and small businesses.



YOUR ROLE:

You are the production end of our content pipeline. Raw footage and a completed brief come to you, and finished video and graphics go back out. You will not set strategy, d
 what gets produced, or run shoots. Your responsibility is execution: correct pacing, clean captions, accurate brand application, and delivery on schedule.



The majority of the work is short-form video, primarily reels cut from footage shot by us or our clients. The remainder is still graphics and templated Meta carousels.



A note on client mix: most of our current clients are churches, nonprofits, and small businesses. Christian schools are our focus going forward, and school work takes priority in the production queue. Expect the mix to shift over the next year.



RESPONSIBILITIES: 

1. Short-form video editing. Cut reels from supplied footage and written briefs. Tight pacing, clean and accurate captions, music synced, and a hook that lands within the first two seconds. Turn around first drafts quickly and handle revisions without friction.



2. Graphic design. Build still graphics and multi-image Meta carousels from templates. Correct alignment, correct dimensions, no errors.



3. Brand consistency. Each client has a documented brand kit covering fonts, colors, logos, and tone. You are expected to work inside it without reminders, and to help maintain and extend our reusable template library.



4. Throughput and communication. Work from our Asana board. Pick up briefs, meet deadlines, post clean first drafts, and act on revision notes as given. Raise unclear briefs or at-risk deadlines the same day you identify them rather than after the deadline passes. This last point carries real weight in how we evaluate performance.



SCHEDULE:

This role requires full overlap with our business hours. Your working hours must fall entirely within 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. 



REQUIREMENTS:

- Availability for 30 hours per week, starting immediately

- Working hours entirely within 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central, Monday through Friday

- Clear, professional written and spoken English

- A computer and internet connection capable of sustained video editing

- Comfort working in a Christian, faith-based context. You do not need to be religious, but our clients are, and the work centers on their mission

- Demonstrated ability to produce consistent volume on deadline without supervision



TOOLS:

- Asana for briefs, deadlines, and tracking. 

- Canva for graphics and carousels, since our templates need to remain editable by the whole team. 

- Google Workspace. 

- Loom for training and progress updates. 

- Slack for daily communication.



For video, use whichever editor you work best in: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut. We do not require a specific application. DaVinci Resolve is a plus, as is Photoshop, but neither is required.



We will train you on Asana and our internal workflows. Editing ability, speed, and reliability matter more to us than familiarity with any particular tool.



RATE AND PROGRESSION:

Starting rate: $8 to $10 per hour, depending on experience.



The first 30 days is a paid trial period. We train you on our clients, brand kits, and editing standards. By the end of it you should be able to take a brief and footage and deliver a finished, on-brand piece with minimal direction. At day 30 both parties d
 whether to continue.



After that, you receive a color-coded performance scorecard every one to two weeks.



Hours begin at 30 per week and grow toward full-time as we add school clients.



HIRING PROCESS:

Strong proposals move to a short paid task. You receive real footage from a current client, the actual brief, and that client's brand kit, and produce one reel of 30 to 40 seconds within 48 hours. This pays $25 flat regardless of outcome. We then send one round of revision notes to see how you work with direction.



No unpaid test work at any stage.



HOW TO APPLY:

Answer the following screening questions, and include a link to your portfolio. If you worked from someone else's footage or brief, let us know.



1. Link two reels and one graphic/thumbnail/carousel you made yourself. One line on each describing what you specifically did.



2. What program(s) do you edit in, and how long have you been using it?



3. How many short-form videos did you deliver in your busiest week?



4. Walk me through your process from receiving raw footage to delivering a finished reel. Include any tools, presets, or shortcuts you use to move faster.



5. Describe a time you got a brief or instruction you couldn't complete as written. What did you do?

title: AWS / Linux Infrastructure Engineer (US Night Shift, Full Time)
description:
ABOUT US



Shopper Approved is an established US-based SaaS company serving about 3,000 clients. We run an AWS-hosted PHP/Laravel platform and work asynchronously with a development team in Pakistan. Our staff is distributed across the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines. This is a permanent, full-time, 100% remote role.



THE ROLE



You own the infrastructure side of a live production SaaS platform. You keep it healthy and recoverable, you make deployments safer, and you replace manual server work with automation that actually holds up. A separate specialist owns employee IT and helpdesk — you will never be asked to reset someone's password or fix a printer.



This is a real production-ownership role. You will hold privileged access to systems that 3,000 paying clients depend on. We are looking for someone who has carried that weight before and treats it seriously.



READ THIS FIRST — SCHEDULE



Working hours are 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday through Friday.



In Philippine time that is:



9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PHT (mid-March through early November)

10:00 PM to 7:00 AM PHT (early November through mid-March)



Yes, this is a permanent night shift. The one-hour move twice a year is US daylight saving; the Philippines does not observe it, so your local hours shift with ours. Only apply if you can hold this schedule reliably, year-round, long term.



The upside of this schedule: you overlap with US leadership for essentially your entire shift, and with our development team in Pakistan for roughly the first five hours. You will not be working in isolation.



Occasional approved maintenance windows or critical i
 may fall outside your regular hours. This is not continuous 24/7 on-call coverage, and we do not expect you to be reachable around the clock.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Day-to-day AWS and Linux production infrastructure operations

Ubuntu application servers, Nginx/Apache, PHP-FPM, queues, workers, scheduled jobs, TLS, storage, and capacity

EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3, monitoring, backup, restoration, i
 triage, and cost signals

Golden/base AMI creation, patching, validation, promotion, rollback, and retirement

Datadog and CloudWatch observability, and alerts that are actually actionable

Platform readiness, post-deploy validation, and rollback support for deployments initiated by our development partner from Bitbucket

Infrastructure automation, source-controlled operational change, runbooks, and clean asynchronous handoffs

Reviewed security, IAM, network, backup, and cost improvements



WHAT YOU WILL NOT OWN



Employee laptops, SaaS access,
 quarantine, onboarding/offboarding, printers, or office helpdesk

Application feature development

Unilateral high-risk architecture changes or production-network migration

Any physical or onsite work

Sole 24/7 coverage



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Three or more years of hands-on Linux and cloud operations, or equivalent depth you can demonstrate

Production AWS work with EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3, monitoring, and backups

Production web operations with Nginx or Apache, plus real process and service troubleshooting

Repeatable patching, image creation, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code

Deployment, rollback, i
 response, and restoration you have actually tested — not just configured

Bash, Python, or another practical automation language

Strong written English and sound judgment with privileged production access

A reliable primary internet connection and a practical backup plan (mobile data, second ISP, or a nearby fallback location)



HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED



PHP/Laravel, PHP-FPM, Supervisor, or Laravel Horizon operations

Datadog APM, logs, and metrics; Cloudflare

Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Packer, or EC2 Image Builder

Migrating legacy infrastructure into something repeatable

SOC 2 or another evidence-driven control environment



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Genuine ownership of the platform, with the authority to fix root causes instead of patching symptoms

Direct access to US leadership during your shift — no layers between you and a decision

A documented environment and a defined scope

Long-term stability; we are hiring for years, not for a project



COMPENSATION



$1200 USD per month, depending on demonstrated experience and the final employment arrangement. Local-currency payment, benefits, leave, holidays, equipment, and after-hours terms will be written into the offer. Night-shift hours are reflected in the rate.



HOW WE HIRE



A structured screen focused on production systems you personally owned

A scenario-based technical and security interview

A paid 90-minute synthetic production-i
 assessment

A live defense of your work, with the facts changed on you

References from people who directly observed your production work



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SNAPSHOT so we know you read the whole posting. Applications without it are not reviewed.



Then answer these six questions directly. Be specific — vague answers get filtered immediately.



Describe the largest production environment you personally operated. How many servers, roughly what traffic, and what was your actual scope of responsibility?

Walk us through one production i
 you handled end to end. What broke, how did you find it, what did you do, and what did you change afterward so it could not happen again?

Have you personally performed a real restore from backup — not a configuration, an actual restore? Describe it.

What have you automated that replaced manual server work? Tools, approach, and what it saved.

Confirm you can reliably work 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PHT (10:00 PM to 7:00 AM during US winter), Monday through Friday, year-round. Describe your internet setup and your backup plan.

What monthly rate are you looking for?



Please do not send a generic cover letter or a copy-pasted résumé blast. We read every application that follows these instructions.

title: Junior Virtual Assistant
description:
At Enlightening Motherhood, we help parents of neurodivergent children build emotional resilience and stronger family relationships through online classes, coaching, and education. We're a small, heart-centered team doing big things — and we're growing.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA who takes ownership of their work and loves bringing order to a creative, mission-driven space.

_______



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Video editing and clipping using Riverside/Capcut

• Creating social media graphics and thumbnails in Canva

• Scheduling and repurposing content across platforms

• Uploading and organizing course content in Thrivecart and Skool

• Supporting general admin and operations as the business grows



---



TOOLS WE USE

Descript · Canva · Metricool · Google Workspace · Slack · Asana · Thrivecart · Heartbeat · Flodesk · WordPress · ChatGPT · Zoom



We don't expect you to know all of them. We do expect you to figure them out.



_______________



THIS IS FOR YOU IF



You do what you say you will do

You message ahead of time — not after — if something comes up

When you hit a tech problem, you search, try, and figure it out before asking for help

You check your work before submitting it

You catch mistakes — yours or a teammate's — and fix them or flag them kindly

You speak up when you have a question, a struggle, or an idea

You are honest, even when it's uncomfortable

You are kind, even when you're correcting someone



This is NOT the right role for you if:



You say yes but then don’t follow through. You agree to be available and then go quiet without any message.

You avoid a task when it feels hard or overwhelming instead of asking for help.

You get stuck on a tech problem and instead of trying to figure it out yourself, you stop working and wait for someone to solve it for you.

You rush through work and don’t check it before submitting.

When you spot a mistake, yours or someone else’s, you ignore it instead of fixing it.

You don’t speak up when you notice something needs attention, or you struggle to point things out kindly.

You keep your struggles to yourself instead of communicating them.

You notify us last minute that you are unavailable.

You’ll be double-tasking while working—simultaneously taking care of kids, prepping meals, or managing other responsibilities.

You skip parts of instructions or move too fast and miss important details.



If any of that sounds like you, please don’t apply. We mean that kindly—this just isn’t the right fit, and that’s okay. We would rather both of us find the right match than waste each other’s time.

_____________________



A few things that matter to us that you won’t find in most job posts



We serve a community of parents who are already exhausted. They come to us because their neurodivergent kids deserve better tools—and so do they. That means the work we do has to be done with care. A task that gets rushed or half-finished doesn’t just create a to-do list problem, it affects real families.



Our team moves fast, thinks creatively, and sometimes needs people who can catch what falls through the cracks without being asked. If you need every detail spelled out before you can move, this won’t feel good for either of us. But if you love bringing order to a creative, mission-driven space and can think on your feet, you will thrive here.



We also use a lot of tools. Not because we love complexity, but because we’re a small team doing big things. We don’t expect you to know all of them. We do expect you to figure them out without needing us to walk you through every step.



We are not a difficult team to work with. We are supportive, we celebrate good work, and we want you to succeed. But we need someone we can trust completely, because we will not be checking on you every hour. You will have real responsibility here, and we want you to own it.

_____________________



Growth of this role



This contract begins part-time at 5–10 hours per week. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us. As the business expands and you prove yourself in this role, we anticipate this engagement increasing in both scope and hours with the potential to grow toward 20+ hours per week and beyond as you develop your expertise and we scale.



We are genuinely looking for a long-term hire. We want to invest in someone who is invested in us. If you are looking for a genuine opportunity to help build something meaningful while growing your own skills, this may be exactly what you’re looking for.



This role requires someone who enjoys bringing order to operations, taking ownership, and continuously improving how things work. If you prefer simply completing assigned tasks rather than improving how things work, this role will likely feel frustrating.



_________________



AVAILABILITY

Monday–Friday with at least 1–2 hours of overlap with US Mountain Time (MST). Full focus while working — no double-tasking.



PAY

$___/hour USD (please include your rate when you apply in the Google Form)





HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a simple reply. COMPLETE THE FULL APPLICATION HERE: 





We read every application personally and are looking for a long-term fit. If this sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.



Warmly,

title: Videographer who can Edit (Based or Can Travel to Metro Manila)
description:
We're looking for a creative and reliable Video Editor / Videographer to join our growing team.



If you're passionate about creating engaging content for social media and enjoy both filming and editing, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be working with businesses across different industries to produce high-quality content for platforms such as Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube.



Responsibilities:

Film high-quality video content on location within Metro Manila.

Edit short-form and long-form videos for social media.

Add captions, motion graphics, transitions, music, and sound effects where appropriate.

Perform color correction and basic audio enhancement.

Organize project files and deliver content on schedule.

Collaborate with our marketing team to bring creative ideas to life.



Requirements:

Must be based or can travel to Metro Manila to to client locations.

Proven experience in both videography and video editing.

Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar editing software.

Experience with Adobe After Effects or motion graphics is a plus.

Comfortable shooting high-quality content using a camera or a modern smartphone.

Strong understanding of current social media trends.

Excellent attention to detail.

Able to work independently and meet deadlines.

Portfolio or demo reel is required.

To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, begin your application with the words Purple Panda.



Please include the following in your application:

Portfolio or demo reel

Current city in Metro Manila

Expected monthly salary (PHP)

Earliest available start date

Editing software you primarily use

Your preferred camera for shooting content (camera or smartphone, including the model you normally use).



If we open your portfolio, which specific video should we watch first? Tell us the title or link, the timestamp (e.g. 0:18–0:35), and explain exactly what your contribution was.



We appreciate thoughtful applications and look forward to seeing your work.

title: AI Animation Video Editor & Creator Needed for E-Commerce Ads
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Animation Video Editor & Creator to produce engaging video advertisements for our e-commerce brand.



This role requires someone who can do more than traditional video editing. You must be able to generate AI-animated scenes and video clips from scratch, then edit those assets together into polished, high-performing ads.



We will provide the scripts, scene breakdowns, visual references, and creative direction. Your responsibility will be to bring those concepts to life using AI video-generation tools and professional video editing.



AI TOOL REQUIREMENT



You must already have access to the AI tools and credits required to perform this work.



We are specifically looking for someone who already works with AI video-generation tools regularly.



You should have experience with tools such as:



Higgsfield

Kling

Runway

Sora

Veo

Seedance

Midjourney

ElevenLabs

Other AI image, video, animation, or voice-generation tools



You do not need to use every tool listed above, but you must already have your own AI-generation workflow and the tools necessary to create a large volume of AI-generated video content.



We will not be providing AI accounts or credits.



Please do not apply if you would need to purchase AI tools or credits specifically to perform the job.
